messages:
Ari: Heads up team — please welcome our new Senior ML Engineer Samir Khan! Samir starts today in SF. :tada:
Samir Khan: Hi everyone! Really excited to join Redwood Inference. Quick bio: previously worked on model serving at a fintech startup, mostly on latency optimizations. Happy to pair on infra or evals. Fun fact: I brew my own coffee and once roasted beans at 400°F (don’t recommend). :coffee:
Lena: Welcome Samir!! If you want a quick tour of our infra config + deploy playbook, happy to set aside 30m today. Also ping me for GitHub org invites. :wave:
Samir Khan: Thanks Lena — that would be awesome. My calendar is open after 2pm PT.
Alex (IT): Welcome Samir — I kicked off laptop provisioning. You should get an email from our device-management system with next steps. If you don’t see it, check spam or DM me and I’ll resend.
Samir Khan: Got the email — thanks. Small question: who do I ask for access to the Dedicated test cluster? I tried the infra onboarding doc but it references a group I can't see.
Maya: Hi Samir — I’m your onboarding buddy this week. For Dedicated test cluster, ping @lena and @alex (IT) — they'll add you to the redwood-dedicated-test group. Also I'll send over a short checklist.
Lena: @Samir Khan I sent the invite to the GitHub org and added you to redwood-dedicated-test. You should be able to ssh into test-gpu-2. Example command: ```ssh samir@test-gpu-2.redwood.internal``` Let me know if you hit permission denied.
Samir Khan: Thanks — ssh worked. Quick follow-up: what's the recommended GPU profile for small perf experiments? I saw notes about sequence length defaults.
Maya: Default is gptx-small (8GB) for quick iterations, gptx-medium (16GB) for end-to-end perf tests. Also use --batch 8 for latency-sensitive runs. We can walk through this in our 1:1.
people-ops-bot: Welcome message — Samir Khan was added to the #new-hires channel and has been assigned onboarding buddy Maya. First-day checklist: tax forms, benefits link, security training.
onboarding-bot: Reminder — mandatory security training assigned to Samir Khan, due in 7 days.
Lena: Also FYI Samir, for local dev you'll want to set these env vars: ```export REDWOOD_ENV=dev
export REDWOOD_REGION=us-west1``` and then run `make dev`.
Samir Khan: Awesome. I ran `make dev` and the frontend loaded. Thanks for the notes. Looking forward to pairing with you all.
Ari: Welcome aboard again! Lunch on us today — ping #lunch-plans if you want to join folks in the office. :pizza:
